description: Lower-order massless nf=5 QCD RG demonstration: beta0,1; Gamma0,1; gammaF0; d1=0,d2. NOT an N3LL-prime numerical prediction.
sources: Collins and Rogers, arXiv:1705.07167v3, two-loop CS and one-loop noncusp conventions; formulas retained in note Sections 12 and 15.
note: The engine supports four/ four/ three/ three loop vectors. No unknown physical coefficient is filled with a mock value in this demonstration.
